name: Dastkar Prashikshan (I.T.I)
benefit: - To benefit the youth by connecting them with employment or self-employment opportunities in the private sector through skill training provided by district ITIs. - The duration of this training is either 1 year or 2 years.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have passed Class 8 or Class 10. 1. The fee is currently fixed at ₹4,000/- per annum.
